ns2:group.ns2:title: Rakuten fixes issues twice as fast with Codex
ns2:group.ns2:description:
Rakuten operates one of the world’s largest digital ecosystems across e-commerce, fintech, and mobile services. Shipping fast without sacrificing reliability is critical.
Teams use OpenAI Codex to support incident response, code review, and development workflows. The agent works inside monitoring systems and CI/CD pipelines to diagnose issues, review changes against internal standards, and advance projects from partial specifications.
The result is faster recovery and faster shipping. Rakuten reports up to a 50% reduction in mean time to recovery, and projects that once took a quarter can now ship in weeks.
As Codex handles more generation, engineers focus on clearer specifications and rigorous verification. The shift helps teams move quickly while keeping safety built into every release.

During the Chinese New Year period, various ball games, spinning tops, and other competitive sports are organized in towns and villages inhabited by the Zhuang and Yao ethnic groups in Guangxi. Additionally, there are unique and free activities such as catching pigs, chickens, ducks, and geese, where the aim is to showcase quick reflexes and enjoy the lively atmosphere. Participants can also sign up to join in the fun!
广西春节特别活动，春节运动会，广西壮族/瑶族乡镇春节期间举办球类、打陀螺等比赛运动，更有别开生面的免费抓猪、抓鸡鸭鹅等活动，比的就是谁手快，看个热闹，也可以报名参与！
